skill1: ■ Affects 2 random ally unit(s) with debuffs.
skill2: ■ Activates when attacking with Full Charge. Affects self.
Professional Tomato Sauce: Damage Taken ▼ 4.37%, stacks up to 15 time(s) and lasts for 5 sec.
burst: ■ Activates when Professional Tomato Sauce is at max stacks. Affects all enemies.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 trigger/cadence is kit-silent — the prose carries no activation clause, so it is modeled as an interval (20 s placeholder). Pin from the datamined skill cooldown before trusting any recovery-event count.

⚑ skill1 restores COVER HP, not unit HP. It is offensively inert on its own (no HP pool at scope lock); it is authored as a `heal` solely so tandem on-recovery consumers (crown-style 'when recovery takes effect') can fire. Whether cover-HP restoration counts as recovery in-game is UNVERIFIED — if it does not, delete this block.

⚑ skill2's Professional Tomato Sauce is a SELF Damage-Taken reduction: purely defensive, with no engine stat to carry it (the schema's damageTakenPct is a boss debuff, opposite semantics). Only its stack COUNT is load-bearing, and its sole consumer (the burst enemy ATK ▼) is itself defensive, so the stack pool is not tracked.

⚑ Derived steady state: ammo 6, chargeFrames 60 (~1 s) + ~22 f release latency ≈ 1.37 s per full-charge shot, reload 141 f ≈ 2.35 s; each stack lasts 5 s, so ~3–4 stacks are concurrently live and the 15-stack cap is unreachable without external charge-speed/ammo support. The burst's max-stack gate therefore likely never opens. Unverified — count stacks in footage before relying on it.
⚑ Cadence tuple (pullsPerSec / chargeFrames 60 / reloadFrames 141) comes from datamine fields with a known reliability problem; the derivation above inherits that uncertainty.

Modeled damage contribution is ZERO: every kit line is defensive, cleanse, or cover repair. In the sim cocoa contributes burst gauge, her Burst I cast, and (if the heal block is real) recovery events only.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Model as authored: skill1 emits a single ally-wide recovery event on a ⚑20 s interval, standing in for the Cover-HP restoration so heal-synergy teammates can fire; nothing else in the kit is represented. The skill1 cleanse (2 random allies, 1 debuff) and the burst cleanse are unmodeled — the sim has no debuff pool and the scope-lock boss applies none. skill2's Professional Tomato Sauce (self Damage Taken ▼ 4.37%, ≤15 stacks, 5 s) is unmodeled: self damage reduction has no engine stat (damageTakenPct is the boss-side debuff, opposite direction) and the boss deals no modeled damage. The burst's max-stack-gated enemy ATK ▼ 13.59% is unmodeled for the same reason — reducing the boss's ATK changes no damage the sim computes — so no resource pool or resourceGate is authored to feed it. skill2 and burst are therefore genuinely effect-free arrays, not omissions. cocoa's live sim contribution is burst-gauge generation, her Burst I cast, and the recovery events above.

SELF damage-taken reduction: defensive, and the schema's damageTakenPct is the boss-side debuff (positive = boss takes more) — encoding it on self would be a stat misidentification. Its stack count only gates the burst's ATK ▼, which is itself inert, so no resource pool is authored. ⚑ derived steady state ~3–4 stacks, cap unreachable.
Cleanse — no debuff model (same reason as the skill1 cleanse).

Enemy ATK ▼ reduces the boss's damage OUTPUT, which the sim does not model (immortal-player scope lock). Purely defensive; no StatKey represents it. Gate condition (max Tomato Sauce stacks) is ⚑ likely unreachable in any case.

flags.estimate: 20 s interval, first fire at t=20 s
flags.reasoning: The kit prose carries no activation clause for skill1, so the trigger-identity rule resolves it to `interval`; the packet states no skill cooldown (the 20 s it gives is her Burst I cooldown). 20 s is borrowed as a deliberately conservative placeholder — a longer interval emits fewer recovery events and so under- rather than over-credits any tandem heal-synergy consumer.
flags.recipe: Read cocoa's datamined skill-1 cooldown (skillCooldownsSec in the characters/skill-levels data) and set `sec` to it, first-fire t=CD per the interval convention; cross-check by counting heal popups on cocoa in a recorded fight and dividing 180 s by the popup count.

flags.estimate: Present — cover-HP restoration modeled as a recovery event
flags.reasoning: Heal/shield/HP lines are never skipped on isolation grounds because a teammate's 'when recovery takes effect' damage buff may consume them. But this line restores COVER HP, not unit HP, and whether cover repair satisfies on-recovery consumers in-game is not stated anywhere in the kit text. Authored present so the tandem channel exists, flagged because it may be a false recovery source.
flags.recipe: Run a comp pairing cocoa with an on-recovery consumer (crown-style) and watch whether the consumer's buff icon/popup appears on cocoa's skill-1 cast in footage with no other healer present. Absent → delete the block; present → keep and pin the cadence per the flag above.

flags.reasoning: Charge cadence ≈ chargeFrames 60 (1.0 s) + ~22 f release latency ≈ 1.37 s per full-charge shot; ammo 6 then reloadFrames 141 ≈ 2.35 s. Within one stack's 5 s life that is ~3.6 shots, and the reload gap lets the oldest stacks lapse — so the pool sawtooths well below 15. This is the stack/currency steady-state ⚑ derived from kit-stated values, not measured.
